description: Morlane is a Mac-native app for building, training, testing, and exporting local AI model projects.
highlights: Create local Tiny LM projects with editable files and configurations.
Import text data, build inspectable JSONL datasets, and review examples before training.
Train locally with MLX, monitor logs and metrics, test checkpoints, and export complete project folders.
name: Morlane
subtitle: Build local AI model projects.
